_meta.title: Colossians — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 4 chapters of Colossians. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 51 Colossians); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~2-4, scaled to chapter substance)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton); text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
verses.plain: For in him all things were created, in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible — whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through him and for him.

verses.text: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
verses.plain: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.

verses.text: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
verses.plain: God chose to make known among the nations the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

verses.text: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
verses.plain: So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live your lives in him,

verses.text: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
verses.plain: rooted and built up in him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.

verses.text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
verses.plain: Set your mind on things above, not on earthly things.

verses.text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
verses.plain: Let the peace of God rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace. And be thankful.

verses.text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
verses.plain: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

verses.text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
verses.plain: Whatever you do, work at it wholeheartedly, as for the Lord and not for people,

verses.text: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
verses.plain: Devote yourselves to prayer, staying alert in it with thanksgiving.

verses.text: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
verses.plain: Let your conversation always be full of grace, seasoned with salt, so you'll know how to answer everyone.
